why_action_is_still_bounded: The campaign has delivered zero impressions since the exact-heavy replacement groups went live.
Fresh India Keyword Planner evidence confirms directly relevant category and OTP-fraud demand.
The daily Search budget remains INR 20, limiting financial exposure.
No App campaign, conversion, location, language, network, landing-page, or negative-keyword control changes.

guardrails: Do not judge before seven days plus a two-day conversion lag.
Review search terms within 72 hours and add only evidence-backed negatives if irrelevant demand appears.
Pause the recovery resources if spend resumes but paid-attributed default_sms_set remains zero after the minimum read.
